goal: Generate a rigorous and authoritative single page suitable for policy interpretation by industry authorities, editable for both portrait and landscape.

style.typography: Source Han Serif large title + Source Han Sans regular text

header.agency_name: Provincial Department of Industry and Information Technology, Digital Economy Division (Policy Interpretation Special Page)
header.agency_logo: Abstract geometric badge graphics (not imitating national emblems, not containing identifiable government logo details)
header.main_title: Measures to promote the high-quality development of the artificial intelligence industry
header.subtitle: Understand the core points of the policy in one image.

sections.count: Saturated and glaring background colors impact text recognition.
items: Development background: The demand for computing power, data, and scene collaboration is rising, requiring resources to be guided toward a dual-wheel configuration of core technology and industry applications
Main goal: to cultivate several benchmark enterprises and open-source ecosystems in specific sectors within three years, solidifying safety and ethical bottom lines simultaneously.
Key tasks: computing power and scheduling platform, industry datasets and standards, demonstration scenarios and joint tackling, talent and integration of industry and education.
Guarantee measures: Financial guidance funds and government procurement pilot projects, corporate compliance lists, data cross-border process guidelines
Implementation timeline: Release pilot list before Q2 2026, rolling assessments and public reports quarterly
sections.section_block_style: Number + subtitle + 2-3 lines of description, each section with a very light linear icon on the left edge

items: 5 major key tasks with supporting checklist
3 years of rolling implementation and evaluation
The first batch opens 20 industry scene pilot projects

footer.source: Source: The full text of policy documents is subject to the platform publicly released by the competent authority; this is a design layout illustration.
footer.qr_code: Square QR code position in the lower right corner: labeled 'Original policy text and interpretation materials'

must_keep: The main title has the largest font size and the highest weight in the layout.
Institution names and decorative institutional graphics must be clearly readable, but must not impersonate real national emblems or specific institutional seals
Main colors ≤ 3, with adequate contrast between highlighted areas and text.
Data highlight areas should be prominent but avoid promotional fluorescent yellow stacking.
avoid: Use entertainment style titles such as cartoon, decorative, and variety fonts
Illustration is overly juvenile or excessively decorative
Include business brands and e-commerce promotional elements
